claims.claim: 大多数胸痛并非严重疾病征兆，但仍应寻求医疗建议；怀疑心脏病发作时应立即寻求医疗帮助。
claims.supportQuote: Most chest pain is not a sign of anything serious but get medical advice just in case. Get immediate medical help if you think you're having a heart attack.
claims.applicability: 适用于对胸痛的自我判断与求助边界；为英国 NHS 患者指引，中国读者拨打 120。
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面层级；为通用患者指引，非诊断标准。

claims.claim: 突发不缓解的胸部疼痛或不适（压榨、压力、烧灼或消化不良感）、放射至手臂颈颌腹背、或伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气短时，可能是心肌梗死，应立即拨打急救电话。
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 适用于新发或疑似心肌梗死的胸痛；英国急救号码 999，中国为 120。
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面层级；症状列举为指引性而非诊断标准。

claims.claim: 心绞痛与心肌梗死症状相似，但心肌梗死危及生命。
claims.supportQuote: angina or a heart attack – which have similar symptoms but a heart attack is life-threatening
claims.applicability: 用于区分心绞痛与心肌梗死两个实体的临床含义。
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面层级；未给出二者鉴别诊断的定量指标。

claims.claim: 冠心病风险随吸烟、肥胖、高血压、糖尿病、高胆固醇及 60 岁以下近亲的心梗或心绞痛史而升高。
claims.supportQuote: you may be at risk of coronary heart disease if you: … smoke … are living with obesity … have high blood pressure , diabetes or high cholesterol … have a history of heart attacks or angina in family members under 60 years old
claims.applicability: 用于冠心病危险因素的罗列；作为转诊评估入口的参考之一。
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面层级；为一般人群健康教育口径。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验、6276 例冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis.
claims.applicability: 纳入人群为冠心病患者，非无症状窦性心律不齐受检者；用于界定已研究人群。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究多为小样本、单中心，且全部来自中国。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸相较其他治疗改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26 至 1.38，P < 0.001），但研究间异质性显著（I² = 62.3%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Pooled analysis indicated significant benefits of suxiao jiuxin pill on ECG outcomes (RR 1.32; 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, P < 0.001). However, there was significant heterogeneity between studies with respect to ECG results ( I 2 = 62.3%).
claims.applicability: 结局为心电图改善这一替代终点，非临床结局；人群为冠心病患者。
claims.uncertainty: 异质性显著（I²=62.3%）；结局为替代指标。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸与硝酸甘油比较，改善心电图结果（RR 1.35，95% CI 1.16 至 1.56，P < 0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: suxiao jiuxin pill improved ECG results more than salvia tablets (RR 1.54; 95% CI 1.41 to 1.67, P < 0.001), isosorbide dinitrate (RR 1.14; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.22, P = 0.001), nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 比较对象为硝酸甘油；结局为心电图改善。
claims.uncertainty: 替代终点；亚组异质性中度（I²=39.1%）。

claims.claim: 多数纳入研究因缺乏双盲设计 Jadad 评分低。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design ( Table 2 ).
claims.applicability: 用于判定证据体的方法学质量下限。
claims.uncertainty: 方法学质量低，直接降低证据确定性。

claims.claim: 所有纳入研究均在中国进行；主要结局为心电图改善（静息心电图恢复正常或次极量运动试验转阴）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome of the selected studies was the improvement in ECG results, including resting ECG returning to normal or negative submaximal exercise test. … All of the included studies were conducted in China.
claims.applicability: 界定研究人群地域与结局性质；结局为替代指标而非临床事件。
claims.uncertainty: 全部来自中国，外推性受限；未分析心血管死亡等临床结局。

claims.claim: 不良反应以轻度头痛、头晕、面部潮红最常见，多自行缓解；不良反应率与对照组无显著差异（RR 1.12，95% CI 0.50 至 2.51，P = 0.785）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously. … There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 不良反应证据限于冠心病患者；无分母级系统监测数据。
claims.uncertainty: 无分母；不良反应发生率点估计宽泛（95% CI 0.50 至 2.51）。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的主要成分为冰片与川芎。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The main components of suxiao jiuxin pills are borneol and Ligusticum chuanxiong Hort
claims.applicability: 机制层面的成分描述，不构成临床疗效证据。
claims.uncertainty: 机制描述与临床证据分列。

claims.claim: 单一异常心电图所见因判别力低，不推荐用于低风险普通人群的心血管事件风险分层。
claims.sourceTitle: Electrocardiography score based on the Minnesota code classification system predicts cardiovascular mortality in an asymptomatic low-risk population
claims.supportQuote: The use of a single abnormal finding on electrocardiography (ECG) is not recommended for stratifying the risk of cardiovascular (CV) events in low-risk general populations because of its low discriminative power.
claims.applicability: 适用于无症状低风险体检人群对单项心电图所见的解读。
claims.uncertainty: 为研究对既有立场的转述，判别力低是其直接理由。

claims.claim: 临床实践指南不推荐在普通人群心血管风险分层中使用静息心电图，因无随机对照试验证实静息心电图筛查的获益。
claims.sourceTitle: Electrocardiography score based on the Minnesota code classification system predicts cardiovascular mortality in an asymptomatic low-risk population
claims.supportQuote: clinical practice guidelines do not recommend using resting ECG in CV risk stratification in general populations because no randomized controlled trials (RCTs) have investigated the benefits of resting ECG for health screening
claims.applicability: 用于界定静息心电图在健康筛查中的位置。
claims.uncertainty: 为研究对临床实践指南立场的转述。

claims.claim: 前瞻性社区队列纳入 8419 名无心血管疾病、无相关症状的受试者（平均年龄 52.1 ± 8.9 岁，50.8% 为男性），中位随访 17.4 年，心血管死亡 192 例（2.3%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Electrocardiography score based on the Minnesota code classification system predicts cardiovascular mortality in an asymptomatic low-risk population
claims.supportQuote: 8419 participants who had no prior CV diseases or angina-related symptoms and had available baseline ECG and 10-year ASCVD risk were observed for a median of 17.4 years … The mean age was 52.1 ± 8.9 years, and 4278 participants (50.8%) were males. CV death occurred in 192 participants (2.3%).
claims.applicability: 提供无症状低风险人群心血管死亡的年龄与性别背景；为韩国队列。
claims.uncertainty: 单一人群（韩国 Ansan-Ansung 队列）；结局为死亡登记。

claims.claim: 与心血管死亡风险相关的静息心电图所见是主要和次要 ST-T 异常、心房颤动、前壁 Q 波、后壁 Q 波缺失、左和右胸前导联高振幅、电轴左偏与窦性心动过速。
claims.sourceTitle: Electrocardiography score based on the Minnesota code classification system predicts cardiovascular mortality in an asymptomatic low-risk population
claims.supportQuote: major and minor ST-T wave abnormalities, atrial fibrillation (AF), Q waves in the anterior leads, the lack of Q waves in the posterior leads, high amplitudes of the left and right precordial leads, left axis deviation and sinus tachycardia were associated with higher risks of CV deaths.
claims.applicability: 呼吸性窦性心律不齐不在其列；用于区分需要警惕与不需要警惕的所见。
claims.uncertainty: 队列为韩国人群；未将呼吸性窦性心律不齐作为预测因子。

claims.claim: 呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）指与呼吸周期的吸气和呼气时相紧密耦合的心率变异性，反映迷走神经对窦房结的作用。
claims.sourceTitle: Maturation of the Cardiac Autonomic Nervous System Activity in Children and Adolescents
claims.supportQuote: RSA refers to heart rate variability (HRV) that is closely coupled to inspiratory and expiratory phases of the respiratory cycle and reflects cardiac vagal effects on the sinoatrial node.
claims.applicability: 界定呼吸性窦性心律不齐的生理学定义；为节律变异而非心肌缺血。
claims.uncertainty: 该定义为生理学层面，未给出分型阈值。

claims.claim: 该研究纳入 4820 名 0.5 至 20 岁健康受试者，同时比较心脏交感与副交感活性。
claims.sourceTitle: Maturation of the Cardiac Autonomic Nervous System Activity in Children and Adolescents
claims.supportQuote: aged 0.5 to 20 years … 4820 healthy subjects from childhood to late adolescence
claims.applicability: 提供儿童青少年人群迷走活性的样本量背景。
claims.uncertainty: 样本限于 0.5 至 20 岁；个体间差异大。

claims.claim: 副交感（迷走）活性随年龄呈立方趋势：婴儿期指数上升、儿童中期平台、青春期下降。
claims.sourceTitle: Maturation of the Cardiac Autonomic Nervous System Activity in Children and Adolescents
claims.supportQuote: a cubic trend, with an exponential increase from infancy, a plateau phase during middle childhood, followed by a decrease to adolescence
claims.applicability: 说明窦性心律不齐所见需按年龄分层解读。
claims.uncertainty: 群体均值趋势；个体差异在各年龄均大。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析检索词为冠心病、速效救心丸、冠状动脉疾病，纳入对象为冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Our search terms included “coronary heart disease,” “suxiao jiuxin pill,” and “coronary artery disease.”
claims.applicability: 说明随机对照证据的检索范围限于冠心病/冠状动脉疾病，不含心律失常人群。
claims.uncertainty: 检索词限定本身不排除存在未检索到的其他研究。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的功能主治与随机对照证据一致地限定于冠心病心绞痛这一缺血实体；无冠心病心绞痛诊断、无胸痛症状、仅有窦性心律不齐心电图所见的受检者不在其适应证人群与已研究人群内。
claims.method: 功能主治关键词为冠心病、心绞痛（缺血实体），禁忌为孕妇禁用（说明书索引件）；meta 分析纳入对象为冠心病患者、结局为心电图改善，检索词限定冠心病/冠状动脉疾病（CLM-019、CLM-005）。呼吸性窦性心律不齐为节律变异、非缺血（CLM-016）；心绞痛为缺血所致胸痛、症状与心肌梗死相似（CLM-003）。节律变异实体与缺血实体无诊断交集，故无冠心病心绞痛诊断、仅有窦性心律不齐的受检者不属于功能主治所界定的人群，也不属于随机对照证据的纳入人群。
claims.assumptions: 以说明书功能主治的冠心病心绞痛诊断作为适应证门槛；窦性心律不齐本身不构成冠心病心绞痛的诊断依据；不存在被本次检索遗漏的以心律失常人群为对象的对照研究。
claims.sensitivity: 若存在未检索到的以心律失常人群为对象或以心律指标为终点的对照研究、或说明书其他版本采用更宽的功能主治表述，则结论随之改变；本次检索未获得此类来源，故该推导只支持'无适应证内证据'，不支持'该人群无效'。
claims.applicability: 适用于无胸痛症状、仅有窦性心律不齐的体检受检者人群；不适用于已确诊冠心病心绞痛患者。
claims.uncertainty: 说明书为索引件、官方现行文本待核验；阴性检索只说明未见已发表证据。
